thread:
maria.release: quick ping — we have a scheduled prod push tonight 00:15 PT for v2.14.0 (pin: rc3). Need one person who can actually execute the push and hold the override escrow if we need an emergency rollback.
jamie.oncall: I can take the window but heads-up my MFA YubiKey is on the desk at home. If we need JIT, I need a temporary grant.
kai.sre: we still have the deployer-bot whitelist for the release group. jamie, if your MFA is flaky we can do an ephemeral role via the JIT service for the 2h window.
ana.prodsec: don't do long-lived exceptions. JIT role will emit audit events to KMS/Audit. approve if SRE + release lead sign off.
maria.release: approved from release lead. kai can you create the JIT grant and update the release notes with the canary pin and rollback instruction? keep TTL to 1h beyond the window.
kai.sre: creating ephemeral role now. command: `./jit-grant --user jamie.oncall --role deployer.prod --ttl 3h --reason "v2.14 prod push"` — logs will appear in /var/log/jit-audit.
deploy-bot: [bot] Deployment precheck: canary targets healthy (95%), infra quota OK, model pin confirmed: rc3. Ready for manual press.
jamie.oncall: got the JIT token, MFA validated. will press at 00:15. rollforward plan: deploy -> monitor 3m canary -> 10% traffic -> 50% -> 100%. rollback plan: if latency >200ms p50 or error rate +0.5% for 5m, revert to v2.13 pinned snapshot.
maria.release: copy. add note in the release channel and in the ticket: "Rollback trigger thresholds + who will press revert". also tag @ana.prodsec for post-mortem if anything.
ana.prodsec: noted. once it's done, keep the audit export attached to the ticket. also confirm that the override escrow token (breakglass) is stored only in the vault and requires 2 approvers to fetch.
kai.sre: override token policy is: stored in vault, 2 approvers required, auto-expire 30m after retrieval. I added the policy comment to the release doc.
maria.release: thanks. jamie — ping here when you press and include short summary. :thumbsup:
jamie.oncall: pressing now.
jamie.oncall: ✅ canary started. 3m monitor.
jamie.oncall: canary looks OK, ramping to 10%.
jamie.oncall: 10% steady. no regressions. moving to 50%.
jamie.oncall: 50% good. promoting to 100%.
jamie.oncall: deployment complete. no rollback necessary. attaching audit: https://vault.internal/release-audit/4995001234
maria.release: great job, closing window. will schedule a short post-release sync tomorrow for lessons learned.
